summary: A tower-defense tesla (lightning) tower on the set's common 2.4 m stone footing: an octagonal steel generator… joints turret_yaw; options tier, arc; sockets socket_muzzle, socket_top, muzzle.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.tesla_tower or place "prefab": "tesla_tower" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
